title: Betway launches star-studded global marketing campaign: Betway Clubhouse
summary: The post Betway launches star-studded global marketing campaign: Betway Clubhouse appeared first on Super Group | SGHC Ltd Official Website .

Produced in partnership with London-based agency M+C Saatchi Sport & Entertainment, we’re proud to launch the *Betway Clubhouse,* bringing together an elite line-up of global sporting stars.


Talent is featured from across our extensive stable of partners, including Manchester United, as our newly announced Principal Partner, Arsenal FC, and Manchester City. Also featured are football legend Thierry Henry, UFC champion Dricus du Plessis, six-time MLB All-Star Vladimir Guerrero Jr., members of South Africa’s Springbok rugby squad, and Atlassian Williams F1 Team drivers Carlos Sainz and Alex Albon.


The film highlights the breadth and scale of Betway’s global sporting partnerships, reflecting the brand’s presence across some of the world’s biggest teams, leagues and sporting competitions. It’s a virtual representation of the ultimate game-day destination where sports fans can come together and truly ‘Feel the Action’.


A full 360-degree through-the-line campaign, Betway Clubhouse will serve as Betway’s consistent brand platform integrated through the funnel, for a unique and immersive fan-centric experience.


The campaign is headlined through a long-format advert that will be promoted across Betway’s markets globally, extending beyond the screen to TV, digital and outdoor – along with digital and physical experiences across Betway’s portfolio of partners. The launch coincided with immersive pop-up experiences across the globe – including takeovers of venues in London and Johannesburg this week.


**Neal Menashe, Chief Executive Officer** of **Super Group** , said: “Betway Clubhouse captures the excitement and passion that our customers experience as sports fans every day, while showcasing the truly global nature of the Betway brand. This campaign features an incredible lineup of sporting icons, highlighting the depth and prestige of our partnerships with the world’s elite athletes and organisations.”


**Ross Watson, Managing Director** of **M+C Saatchi Sport & Entertainment** commented: “From the moment we began working with Betway earlier this year, there was a shared ambition to create a brand platform that could match the scale of their global sporting partnerships while putting fans at the heart of the experience. Betway Clubhouse is the result of that ambition, a bold and entertaining creative idea designed to unite world-class talent under one distinctive brand world that can evolve across every touchpoint. It has been a fantastic collaboration with the Betway team, and we’re proud to have helped bring this new chapter for the brand to life.”


The campaign was filmed over ten shoots globally including London, Manchester, Nice and Johannesburg and was produced by Common People alongside Director Virgil Ferragut.
